basic_details.job_title: IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow (ECE) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The ECE Discipline of PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing (IIITDM) Jabalpur has invited applications for one Junior Research Fellow post on the ISRO RESPOND & AI sponsored project "Multi-Modal Satellite Image Registration", a 2-year project. The post carries Rs. 37,000 per month plus campus accommodation or HRA@20% and is open to candidates with an M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc (Engg.) or equivalent post graduate degree who have qualified CSIR-UGC-NET or GATE. Apply through the Google Form by 23 November 2026, 23:59 hours; the interview is on 4 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Category Relaxation SC/ST 5 years OBC 3 years Ex-Servicemen, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), Widows, Divorced Women and Women judicially separated from their husbands and not remarried As per Government of India orders | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/qJjU7W1A4EowytKF8 (also linked under Important Links).
Fill in the form and submit it latest by 23/11/2026, 23:59 hours.

The notice names no documents to attach and no fee. For queries about the position, candidates may contact the PI, Dr. Amit Vishwakarma, ECE Discipline, PDPM-IIITDM Jabalpur, Dumna Airport, Road, Jabalpur, MP- 482005, phone 07612794481 (O) or 8486491176 (M), email [email protected].
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be given to candidates for appearing in the interview and written test. The Institute/PI reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. The post is purely temporary and is tied to the availability of project funds.

content_sections.heading: IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing, Jabalpur
"Multi-Modal Satellite Image Registration" (Sanction No.: DS 2B-13012(2)/26/2022-Sec.2 dated 14 July 2026)
Initially six months, may be extended; project duration 2 years
Rs. 37,000/- per month plus campus accommodation or HRA@20%
ECE Discipline, PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following conditions for the Junior Research Fellow post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.requirement: M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc (Engg.) or equivalent post graduate degree in First Class with an aggregate minimum of 60% or CGPA/CPI grading of 6.5 on a 10 point scale
Only candidates who qualified CSIR-UGC-NET (including lectureship / Assistant Professorship) or GATE are eligible to apply
Good hands-on experience in MATLAB/Python programming will be preferred
Maximum age of 28 years as on 23.11.2026, the closing date of receipt of online applications

rows.category: Ex-Servicemen, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), Widows, Divorced Women and Women judicially separated from their husbands and not remarried
rows.relaxation: As per Government of India orders

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Fellow receives Rs. 37,000/- per month plus campus accommodation or HRA@20%. The post is purely temporary, on the project. The appointment will initially be for six months and may be extended based on satisfactory performance and the availability of project funds. The project itself runs for 2 years. The selected JRF will have the opportunity to register for the regular Ph.D. programme at IIITDM Jabalpur as per the Institute norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Open the Google Form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/qJjU7W1A4EowytKF8 (also linked under Important Links). Fill in the form and submit it latest by 23/11/2026, 23:59 hours. The notice names no documents to attach and no fee. For queries about the position, candidates may contact the PI, Dr. Amit Vishwakarma, ECE Discipline, PDPM-IIITDM Jabalpur, Dumna Airport, Road, Jabalpur, MP- 482005, phone 07612794481 (O) or 8486491176 (M), email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection mode printed in the notice is an interview. It will be conducted offline/online on 4 December 2026 at the ECE Discipline, PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur. The notice does not describe the marking or shortlisting method.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be given to candidates for appearing in the interview and written test. The Institute/PI reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. The post is purely temporary and is tied to the availability of project funds.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts has IIITDM Jabalpur announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 post of Junior Research Fellow on the ISRO RESPOND & AI sponsored project "Multi-Modal Satellite Image Registration".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 23 November 2026, with the Google Form to be submitted by 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF post?
faq.answer: An M.E./M.Tech/M.Sc (Engg.) or equivalent post graduate degree in First Class with an aggregate minimum of 60% or CGPA/CPI of 6.5 on a 10 point scale is required. Only candidates who qualified CSIR-UGC-NET (including lectureship) or GATE are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years as on 23.11.2026. SC/ST candidates get 5 years' relaxation and OBC candidates get 3 years' relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIITDM Jabalpur Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month plus campus accommodation or HRA@20%.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 per month?
faq.answer: The notice states the salary as Rs. 37,000/- per month plus campus accommodation or HRA@20%, so either campus accommodation or HRA at 20% is given in addition to the monthly amount.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF post?
faq.answer: Apply online by filling in the Google Form at https://forms.gle/qJjU7W1A4EowytKF8 latest by 23/11/2026, 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected for the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The selection mode is an interview. It will be held offline/online on 4 December 2026 at the ECE Discipline, PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIITDM Jabalpur JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary. The appointment is initially for six months and may be extended based on satisfactory performance and availability of project funds.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be given to candidates for appearing in the interview and written test.
